name: Mitten Extracts Disposable | Watermelon Z
description: Juicy, sweet, and refreshingly smooth, Watermelon Z is the ultimate indica for flavor lovers. Bursting with candy-like watermelon notes, this 2g disposable offers a deeply relaxing high that’s perfect for evenings, weekends, or anytime you want to slow things down. Bold flavor meets calming effects in a pen designed to satisfy both your sweet tooth and your need to unwind.
